v.deps: Child of EP-57118. Shares the session card component with the time-grid card (EP-57015); decisions of 14 Sep fixed the threshold at 6 hours and titles at 3 lines, and the page was swept from 8 to 6 hours. Still open: whether on-demand sessions appear in the All Day banner ('decision pending separately'). Risk: a contradictory specification would mislead QA on 6 to 8 hour sessions.
v.feature: All Day Session in the calendar view
v.impact: Attendees: clear distinction between ongoing all-day activities and time-specific presentations. Organizers: flexibility to schedule all-day events without disrupting standard speaker tracks.
v.notes: Deployed under parent EP-57118; FE by Oleksandr Zakablukov, QA by Olena Khromei.
v.rationale: Multi-hour and full-day sessions (over 6 hours, such as exhibitions, hackathons or networking lounges) previously stretched across the entire vertical time grid, squishing normal 30-60 min sessions.
v.why: For DLG Agritechnica: 6-hour-plus sessions such as the daily Robotics Live Arena take a grid column and squeeze shorter sessions.
